additional_sections.header: Things to do in Bayonne, NJ
content: From exploring local parks to spending some time shopping or trying a new restaurant, families and singles alike can discover activities to enjoy in Bayonne.
Bayonne has 550 restaurants and 55 bars in the area, so you and your loved ones have options when you decide you don't want to cook at home or when you're in the mood for a drink.
Bayonne locals have access to 100 parks, maintained by both state and federal governments.
Looking for activities away from home? Head to 28Th Street Park And Avenue F, one of Bayonne's landmarks. 11 sporting arenas are also available for sports enthusiasts.
The overall population of Bayonne, NJ, is 65,112 based on the most recent Census from 2020.
Regarding the residents living in Bayonne, NJ, here is a brief rundown:

People living in Bayonne have a median age of 38 years, and women constitute 51% of the population. 52% speak English, 25% speak Spanish, and 23% speak languages other than Spanish or English. 26% of people in Bayonne report holding a Bachelor's Degree as their highest level of education, 9% report having a Master's Degree, and 46% report having a high school diploma. 30% of the population in Bayonne was born abroad, and there are also 1,965 registered veterans.

With 24,784 households in Bayonne, NJ, there is an average of three people per home. The average household income — families and singles — is $69,511 in Bayonne, NJ. Out of the 24,784 households, 59% rent and 41% own their properties. The percentage of residents that have homes with computers is 91%, and the percentage that have homes with high-speed internet is 85%.

intro.header: Searching for apartments in Bayonne, NJ
content: Looking for apartments in Bayonne? If you want to know more information about the area before you make your next move, we can help. Bayonne has a population density of approximately 11,186 people per square mile, covers a region of six square miles, and is located in New Jersey.

If you're wondering how much time it would take to commute from a neighboring city or if you like going on trips to surrounding towns, Bayonne, NJ, is situated a little over four miles from Jersey City and just a short drive away from New York. There are 16 schools and 100 parks close by, as well as shops, landmarks and other points of interest that residents can take advantage of.
Bayonne School District is the public school district.

You're in luck if you enjoy going out of town: You can fly from Newark Liberty International Airport, which is three miles away from Bayonne. There is also La Guardia Airport, which is 15 miles away. For those who enjoy traveling by train rather than by air, the closest train depot is Liberty International Airport Station, four miles away. Also, five miles away is Penn Station, so you have transportation options when booking your next trip.
The median commuting time for Bayonne residents is 35 minutes, and the majority commute by car.
